[b]The January Commitment, January 15, 2027[/b]

It had been almost two years since the collapse of the terrorist Sal-Baliz at the hands of a joint THEP forces, and the Emperor of Thýven, Piter Drømm, had ordered a review of all major spending in the past two years. One of the major red flags that he had seen in the reports that he had been given was an excessive amount of spending (nearly 45 Billion Lyr per year) in maintaining both military bases on West Shamat, which had initially been founded in order to ensure a cohesive resource allocation point for THEP operations. However, now that THEP had completed its top goals in the region, he had begun to question why they needed both bases. As a result, he would order the foreign minister of the Empire to offer the northwestern base to fellow THEP ally, and Shamantine native state, Sikirsk for about 50 Billion Gilder (approx 43 Billion Lyr) in return for further economic cooperation between the two countries.

[quote=the_crystalline_empire;60417681][b]Imperial Christmas Speech, January 7, 2027[/b]
[i]My Fellow citizens,
it is necessary that I wish you a Merry Christmas, the opening of the liturgical year in Thýven, and a beacon of hope for many of our citizens across the principates. It is in this time that we celebrate not only the birth of Isou Kristos, but also the birth of a new empire. The old has passed away and the new has come, a new order, a new way of doing things. The Empire is not an empire of colonialism, nor of autocracy, but one of the people and the emperor. I am like you my fellow citizens, born among you to parents who toiled the ground, and grandparents who worked in the shadows of the factories of the great cities of this nation.

It is wisdom to then discuss the threat which faces our peaceful nation, across the world stands an ideology poised to the ruin of the ideal of Imperium Populi sub Deo, that ideology is Communism. Communism seeks to take the rights of the peoples and distribute them, but fails to recognise the importance of the divine hierarchy, rejecting what God has willed, and instead placing it in the hands of mankind. It is a thievery of the sacred and a rejection of all that is holy. We do not fight Communism as merely an ideological war, but as a war of the faith, for God supersedes politics and ideology. 

As such, it is my solemn oath to you that the state shall stand for you and with you, and shall in Christ, stand as a solemn soldier against the satanic ideology of Communism. May the peace of God go with you, and may Christ dwell with you. Merry Christmas.[/i]
[nation]United Hydronia[/nation]
